{{Top|leg}}
'''Free-style zero-G swimming''' was a sporting competition. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a battle occurred between an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Unidentified Alliance corvette|corvette]] and an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Rebel Alliance corvette)|Star Destroyer]]. The [[Space warfare/Legends|combat]] was observed by a group of [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Unidentified googly-eyed species|aliens]] who misinterpreted the fight as a sporting contest. Prizing fairness in competition and disliking the uneven nature of the contest, the [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] the two crews and brought them aboard their [[fathership]]. The aliens directed the crews to continue their contest in a fairer environment with the aliens acting as [[Judge/Legends|judges]]. Free-style zero-G swimming was one of a number of competitions that the aliens proposed for the crews to compete in, along with [[loudest-howling]], [[acrobatic pyramids]], marksmanship, and [[zero-G mini-speeder go-cart steeplechase]]s.<ref name="Night">{{WEGCite|story=The Night Has a Thousand Eyes|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>
